name: Octavio E. Rodriguez
bio: Octavio E. Rodriguez was born in California, USA. He is a director, known for Coco (2017), Incredibles 2 (2018) and Ron's Gone Wrong (2021).

credits.title: On the Edge
credits.overview: Donnie, a cynical but lovable Cuban solenodon, takes on an outrageous mission: to avoid extinction by rebranding himself as a panda — one of the world’s most beloved endangered species. credits.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse - Creating the Ultimate Spider-Man Movie
credits.overview: Writing, pre-production and the challenges of crafting a sequel to a game-changing film, as told by the filmmakers who worked so hard to push Across the Spider-Verse several steps farther without losing the magic of the first entry in the series.

credits.title: Ron's Gone Wrong
credits.overview: In a world where walking, talking, digitally connected bots have become children's best friends, an 11-year-old finds that his robot buddy doesn't quite work the same as the others do.
